title: People & Team: overview film
description: Introduce the people behind the work. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 31 seconds: the 24 People & Team elements of Desiderio for TYPO3 v14, including team grid, org chart, company history, office locations, career listing, founder quote. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: An about page without faces or history tells visitors nothing about who does the work.
People and Team has 24 elements for the people behind the work.
Team grids, an org chart, company history, offices, open roles and a founder quote.
Show who does the work, and where to find them.
